Don't buy pure cotton T-shirts. They are not good and they lose color quickly and shrink. You have to buy tri blend(50% polyester/25% cotton/25% rayon) or dual blend(60/40 or 50/50) synthetic shirts. I prefer tri blend shirts because they just lie against you body instead of having that boxy structure of cotton. Although good dual blend do the same thing.
